meta.title: Byzantine minority — 3/15 nodes corrupted, network still converges
meta.description: 3 of 15 nodes are seeded with a false claim from round 0. 2 more nodes are offline until round 8. Anti-entropy gossip plus trust-weighted reconciliation should heal the whole network onto the true claim well before round 24 — watch the byzantine nodes' trust erode round over round until they get forced back onto consensus.

claim.question: Who won the Apex Gate-Run Invitational (fictional FPV drone race, used as a demo claim)?

doc_marshal.title: Race Marshal Bulletin — Final Heat
doc_marshal.text: Pilot Vela cleared the last gate 0.4s ahead of the field, taking the Apex Gate-Run Invitational title.

doc_stream.title: Livestream Commentary Transcript
doc_stream.text: ...and Vela takes the checkered gate! Cleanest line through the chicane all weekend.

doc_interview.title: Post-Race Pilot Interview
doc_interview.text: Vela, on the winning run: 'The pack config finally clicked in finals.'

doc_sponsor.title: Sponsor Recap Newsletter
doc_sponsor.text: Congratulations to Vela and the whole podium for an incredible final heat.

doc_recap.title: Season Recap Article
